scenarios.title: Meeting Grandma & Grandpa
scenarios.description: You've just arrived and are meeting your partner's grandparents for the first time. Greet them, introduce yourself, and answer their first questions.

scenarios.title: Family Small Talk
scenarios.description: Sitting in the living room with the family, making easy conversation before dinner.

scenarios.title: At the Dinner Table
scenarios.description: Grandma has made a huge spread. Talk about the food, accept seconds, and be polite about it.

scenarios.title: A Phone Call Home
scenarios.description: Your partner's grandmother calls to check in. Practice phone etiquette and a short catch-up.
